label: Landing page
notes: First impression. Are the value prop and CTA clear?

label: Pricing
notes: Plan comparison + credit bundles. Do tiers feel distinct?

label: Sign up
notes: Email/password vs. Google. Is the choice obvious?

label: Log in
notes: Returning users. Forgot-password discoverable?

label: Workspaces list
notes: Where the existing user lands after sign-in (if they have workspaces).

label: Add a workspace
notes: First-run capture. Only name + website are required; the rest live behind a disclosure.

label: Brand context
notes: Soft step between workspace and first audit. Boost downstream content quality.

label: Brand kit studio
notes: Colors + typography. Used by generated pages and visuals.

label: Launch an audit
notes: Single click + credit confirmation. Wait time = first activation moment.

label: Workspace overview
notes: The hub. Score, priorities, recommended actions, integrations.

label: Visibility
notes: Per-query state — where the brand appears and where it misses.

label: Competitor gaps
notes: Who is showing up instead. Empty state nudges 'Run analysis'.

label: Audit history
notes: Returning users see deltas vs. the previous audit.

label: Content brief
notes: Pick a query, pick a tone. The fastest path from finding to fixing.

label: Content queue
notes: Briefs and drafts in flight. Approve / AI-edit / publish from here.

label: Growth calendar
notes: 4-week schedule built from the latest audit.

label: Position tracking
notes: Score and per-query movement across audits over time.

label: Answer monitor
notes: Re-run individual prompts between audits.

label: Pricing (logged in)
notes: Same page as step 2, but for an authenticated user — does the CTA shift?

label: Settings → Billing
notes: Plan + Stripe portal + workspace seats.

label: Settings → Credits
notes: Top up the wallet without changing plan.

label: Settings → Team
notes: Invite teammates, manage seats.

label: Settings → White-label
notes: Logo + brand colour applied to public reports + PDFs.

label: Help center
notes: Self-serve guidance for everything above.
